title: Core site comparison construction
statement: For finite quotients and a fixed strict-etale evaluation package, there is a comparison C with ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence, bounded-below unit, origin counit, and inverse-origin assertions.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary and derived site comparison, apply finite quotient comparison levelwise, and transport the unit, counit, normalization, and inverse-origin properties through evaluation and the mate identities.

proof_origin.place: Separated boundedness/construction step from Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 09B1.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalSiteOriginComparison_core
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (ell : O)
    [∀ n : ℕ, Finite (O ⧸ (Ideal.span ({ell} : Set O)) ^ (n + 1))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (PE : StrictEtaleEvaluation T O ell) :
    ∃ C : ExceptionalSystemSiteComparison O ell T PE,
      ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence C ∧
      (∀ n M, (∃ a : ℤ, M.IsGE a) →
        IsIso ((C.image.level n).adjunction.unit.app M)) ∧
      (∀ n M, C.levelOrigin n M →
        IsIso ((C.image.level n).adjunction.counit.app M)) ∧
      (∀ n M, (∃ a : ℤ, M.IsGE a) →
        C.levelOrigin n ((C.image.level n).inverse.obj M))
